subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS094]
text: As Young Link in the Spirit Temple, solve the Silver Rupee puzzle in the two-sided room, cross the fallen bridge, and use the Boomerang to kill the Gold Skulltula on the wire wall and collect its token.

evidence.quote: Solve the Silver Rupee Puzzle, and when the bridge in the middle of the room falls, cross it and use the Boomerang to kill the Gold Skulltula and take it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS095]
text: As Young Link in the Spirit Temple room with two Lizalfos and a sun panel on the floor, climb to the top of the tiled wall, turn around, and use the Boomerang to kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall and retrieve its token.

evidence.quote: In the room with the pair of Lizalfos and the sun panel on the floor, climb to the top of the tiled wall and turn around at the top.  The Gold Skulltula is here, just behind you and on the wall.  Kill it and take it's token with the Boomerang.

subject: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS096]
text: As Young Link in the Spirit Temple, enter the stairwell immediately before the Iron Knuckle room to find a Gold Skulltula above the south door, then kill it and collect its token using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Enter the stairwell immediately before the room where Young Link fights the Iron Knuckle.  The Gold Skulltula is above the door on the south side of the room.  Kill it and use the Boomerang to take it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #4 [GS099]
text: As Adult Link in the Spirit Temple rolling boulder room with a Silver Rupee puzzle, play the Song of Time to move the Block of Time covering an alcove on the left side to reveal a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Find the room with the rolling boulders and a Silver Rupee puzzle.  On the left side of the room, there is an alcove covered up by a Block of Time.  Move the Block with the Song of Time, to find the Gold Skulltula behind it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #5 [GS100]
text: As Adult Link on the top level of the west side of the Spirit Temple Colossus room, play the Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre to the opposite ledge, pull yourself across using the Hookshot or Longshot, and find the Gold Skulltula behind him.

evidence.quote: Go to the top level of the west side of the room, and play the Scarecrow's Song to make Pierre appear on the opposite ledge.  Pull yourself over to the ledge with the Hookshot or Longshot.  The Gold Skulltula is behind Pierre on this ledge.

subject: Shooting Gallery (Young Link)
text: To win the Big Bullet Bag at the Young Link Shooting Gallery, you must shoot every rupee that appears without missing; missing two or less allows a free retry, while missing more requires paying to play again.

evidence.quote: To win the Big Bullet Bag, you have to shoot every rupee that appears without missing a single one.  If you miss two or less, then the clerk will let you try again for free.  If you miss more then two, you have to pay to play again.

subject: Shooting Gallery (Young Link)
text: During the first run through the Young Link Shooting Gallery, rupees appear in a preset order: in the middle, from the left then right, jumping from the middle, from both left and right, two from the right going left, and two from the left going right.

evidence.quote: For this first run through the Shooting Gallery, the rupees appear in a preset order.  The order is:...1.)  In the middle...2.)  From the left, then from the right...3.)  Jumps from the middle...4.)  From the left AND right...5.)  Two rupees coming from the right, going left...6.)  Two rupees coming from the left, going right

subject: Shooting Gallery (Young Link)
text: Successfully shooting all targets in the Young Link Shooting Gallery awards the Bullet Bag x40, which increases the ammo capacity of your Slingshot by 10.

evidence.quote: Keep playing the minigame until you successfully shoot all of the targets, and the clerk will award you with the Bullet Bag x40, which increases the ammo capacity of your Slingshot by 10.

subject: Shooting Gallery (Young Link)
text: If you run out of rupees while attempting the Shooting Gallery minigame, return to the Hyrule Castle Gatehouse and smash pots to replenish your supplies.

evidence.quote: If you run out of rupees trying to complete the game, then return to the Hyrule Castle Gatehouse and smash the pots to replenish your supplies.

subject: Shooting Gallery (Adult Link)
text: Hitting all targets in one attempt at the Adult Link Shooting Gallery rewards Link with his first Quiver upgrade.

evidence.quote: Keep playing the game until you nail all of the targets in one go, and the clerk will reward you with the first Quiver upgrade.

subject: Shooting Gallery (Adult Link)
text: In the Adult Link Shooting Gallery, if a single blue rupee appears from the left, the next one will always come from the right, and memorizing the target patterns allows you to predict subsequent targets.

evidence.quote: Note number 2: if a single blue rupee comes from the left, then the next one will ALWAYS come from the right, despite the randomness of the rest of it.  Keep this in mind.  Also, if you memorize the patterns that the targets appear in, then you can predict what will appear next, and you can always tell what the last pattern will be by simply looking at what has already appeared.

subject: Horseback Archery Range
text: At the Gerudo Archery Range, you receive twenty arrows to use and must score at least 1,000 points to win a Piece of Heart, with pots worth 100 points each and targets worth up to 100 points in the exact middle.

evidence.quote: You get twenty arrows to use, and in order to win the Piece of Heart from this game you must score at least 1,000 points.  There are huge wooden targets set up along the course as well pots that appear on the way.  Shoot the pots for 100 points each, and the targets are worth varying amounts depending upon how close to the center you are (the exact middle of the target is worth 100 points).

subject: Horseback Archery Range
text: Epona automatically runs up and down the course once in each direction, so focus on hitting the pots and the far north target on the first pass, then shoot the east targets and south target on the second pass.

evidence.quote: Epona will automatically run up and down the course (you get one pass in each direction before the game ends).  On your first pass, focus on hitting the pots as you pass by them.  Once you nail all the pots, focus on the target on the far north side of the course.  On your second pass, shoot for the targets on the east side of the course until you get near enough to accurately hit the target on the south side of the course.

subject: Horseback Archery Range
text: Scoring at least 1,500 points on a subsequent attempt at the Horseback Archery minigame awards the Quiver upgrade.

evidence.quote: Play the game again and score at least 1,500 to earn the Quiver.  If you score 1,500 or more on your first attempt, then you have to play again to earn the Quiver and repeat the feat.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: In Bombchu Bowling, the goal is to send a Bombchu into the hole on the opposite end across three progressively difficult course goals to win the displayed prize.

evidence.quote: The object of Bombchu Bowling is to send the Bombchu (a mobile bomb) into the hole on the opposite end of the course.  The course has three different goals to obtain, each one becoming progressively more difficult.  Completing all three goals successfully will win you whatever prize the clerk showed you at the start.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: The first Bombchu Bowling goal has a center target guarded by a Blade Trap, the second level target can be top, left, or right with a moving small Cucco, and the last goal is in the exact center guarded by a Fat Cucco.

evidence.quote: For the first goal, the target is always in the center of the field.  Simply stand in the exact middle of the field (slightly to the right of the center arrow is the exact middle of the field) and time it so your Bombchu avoids the Blade Trap.  The next level of the field can be on the top, left, or right, and adds a small Cucco to dodge...The last goal is always in the exact center, and adds a Fat Cucco who always stands roughly in the center of the field (but you can sneak a Bombchu by it if you're careful).

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: Always position yourself in the center of the field during Bombchu Bowling except when the second round target is on the right, and if the hole is on the left, angle the Bombchu along the floor then the wall into the hole.

evidence.quote: When you're playing Bombchu Bowling, always position yourself in the center of the field.  The one exception is when the target appears on the right in the second round; you have to minorly adjust your position to the left or right, otherwise it's impossible to angle yourself properly for the Bombchu to enter the target.  If the hole appears on the left side of the field, then adjust your angle so that the Bombchu goes along the floor, then the wall, then into the hole.
